plainText:
Goh's Mantyke (Japanese: ゴウのタマンタ Go's Tamanta) is the first that Goh in the Sinnoh region, and his nineteenth overall.

==In animation==
===History===
==== ====
 ]]
 debuted in The Sinnoh Iceberg Race!, where Goh caught it soon after he arrived in Snowpoint City. Goh later used Mantyke as his entry Pokémon in the Pokémon Iceberg Race, where it competed well before going back to assist Ash's Pikachu, who was struggling. This act saved them from being caught in 's trap. Working together, Mantyke and Pikachu were able to free the Pokémon that were captured before sending Team Rocket blasting off. Because of the trio's interference, the race ended up being cancelled, with no winner being officiated.

In Panic in the Park!, Mantyke was one of the Pokémon affected by the disappearance of food at the Cerise Park. When the group led by Goh's Scyther and subsequently clashed, the group formed by the Pokémon join the fray. Mantyke is seen being affected along with other Pokémon by the combination of the exhaled by and .
 
In Looking Out for Number Two!, Goh used Mantyke to find a as part of his second Trial Mission for Project Mew. Later, when Goh finally encounterd a Kingdra, he uses Mantyke in conjunction with in a battle against the Dragon-type Pokémon to prevent it from escaping. This allowed Goh to capture Kingdra and thus get his second Project Mew token.

In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Mantyke attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.

===Personality and characteristics===
When Goh chose to enter Mantyke in the Pokémon Iceberg Race, Mantyke didn't look too happy at being entered. Later, during the race, Mantyke was kind and helpful, as seen when it stopped competing and went back to assist Ash's Pikachu when it was struggling.

===Moves used===
 
 
 
 

==In the games==
===Pokémon GO===
On November 6, 2020, as part of Pokémon GO's Animation Week 2020 event, which was based on , several Pokémon based on those that Ash and Goh encountered in the animated series appeared more frequently in the wild, in , from 7 km Eggs, and during surprise encounters, with Mantyke appearing only in 7 km Eggs. The event ran from November 6, 2020, at 8:00 a.m., to November 12, 2020, at 10:00 p.m. local time.

==Trivia==
Mantyke is Goh's only .
Mantyke is also Goh's only baby Pokémon.
